title: Does every figure have a smallest angle of symmetry?
description: The windmill has a smallest angle of symmetry, and the circle is turned by many angles to see what happens. A circle coincides with itself after every turn. Keeko's doubt is that a circle must have a smallest angle too.
teaching_notes: One idea: most figures have a smallest angle of symmetry, but the circle fits after every angle, so it has none. Watch for students who think every figure must have a smallest angle.

source: Is there a smallest angle of symmetry for all figures?
video_script.why: The child sees that most figures have a smallest angle of symmetry, but the circle does not, because it fits after every angle.
video_script.substitution: the book's windmill and the book's circle, turned about their centres
video_script.anchor: the book's windmill and the book's circle, each with a dot at its centre
video_script.wrong_answer: a circle has a smallest angle too
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says a circle must have a smallest angle of symmetry, like every other figure.
video_script.payoff_line: Most figures have a smallest angle of symmetry, but a circle does not

final_answer.value: No. Most figures have a smallest angle of symmetry, but a circle does not: every angle is an angle of symmetry for a circle
final_answer.spoken: no, most figures have a smallest angle of symmetry, but a circle does not, because every angle is an angle of symmetry for a circle

hold_back: Most figures have a smallest angle of symmetry, but a circle does not
maths_rules: the windmill fits at 90°, 180°, 270°, 360°; the smallest is 90°, and no smaller turn fits
a circle coincides with itself after any turn, for example 90°, 45° or 10°
so every angle is an angle of symmetry for a circle, and it has no smallest angle
if a circle fits after 1°, it fits after half a degree too, and after every smaller turn
video_script.design: The windmill with its smallest angle of ninety degrees, then a circle turned by ninety, forty five and ten degrees. Keeko's doubt is that a circle has a smallest angle too.
